RDAX Instruction.description: Read register * COEFF, add to ACC  (ACC = ACC + REG*C)

WRAX Instruction.description: Write ACC to register, then scale ACC  (REG = ACC; ACC = ACC*C)

RDFX Instruction.description: Read register through a 1-pole filter  ((ACC-REG)*C + REG)

WRHX Instruction.description: Write ACC to register; high-shelf  (REG=ACC; ACC*C+PACC)

SOF Instruction.description: Scale and offset ACC  (ACC = C*ACC + D)

LOG Instruction.description: ACC = C*log2(|ACC|) + D   (D is S4.6, range +/-16)

SKP Instruction.description: Conditionally skip to a label / over N instructions  (SKP CMASK, N)

RDA Instruction.description: Read delay RAM * COEFF, add to ACC  (ACC = ACC + delay[ADDR]*C)

WRA Instruction.description: Write ACC to delay RAM, then scale ACC  (delay[ADDR]=ACC; ACC*C)

WRAP Instruction.description: Write ACC to delay RAM; scale and add last delay read (all-pass)

RMPA Instruction.description: Read delay RAM via ADDR_PTR * COEFF, add to ACC (indirect)

WLDS Instruction.description: Load a sine LFO with frequency and amplitude

WLDR Instruction.description: Load a ramp LFO with frequency and amplitude

JAM Instruction.description: Reset the specified ramp LFO (RMP0 or RMP1) to its starting position

CHO RDA Instruction.description: LFO-modulated delay read (chorus, pitch shift). flags: SIN COS REG COMPC COMPA RPTR2 NA

CHO SOF Instruction.description: LFO-coefficient scale and offset (cross-fade for pitch shift)

CHO RDAL Instruction.description: Read the current value of the selected LFO into ACC

EQU Directive.description: Define a symbolic constant  (asfv1 directive-first order)
